title: Kneaded Light Japanese Gyoza
description: A traditional Japanese dish featuring a light and airy dough wrapped around a savory filling, made with shortening and laminated to create a puff pastry effect.
instructions: Combine flour, yeast, and salt in a large mixing bowl.
Add shortening and use a pastry blender to work it into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add warm water and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Rest the dough for 1 hour in a warm place.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch and cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter.
Place a tablespoon of filling in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Heat a large skillet with 1 tablespoon of sesame oil over medium high heat.
Pan fry the gyoza until they are golden brown on the bottom.
Add 1/4 cup of water to the skillet and cover with a lid to steam the gyoza for 2 minutes.
